description: Post an agent failure for a vetted human expert to solve (Step 26 loop): the problem is scrubbed, fault-attributed, dispatched to a matched SOLVER, reviewed, and the verified solution returns via opentrain_poll_updates plus the agent_failure.solved webhook. Requires failures:write + the agent_failure_benchmark rollout.

agent.description: The agent/framework that hit the failure.

context.description: Extra context: stack traces, tool output, constraints.

model.description: The model that hit the failure.

openContribution.description: true = contribute the solved pair to the open corpus (zero-margin tier).

problem.description: What went wrong, with enough context for a vetted human expert to solve it. Pre-scrub secrets client-side; the server re-scrubs and rejects residual credentials.

name: opentrain_post_failure
